title: 第13章 斩蛇
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦守的声音不高，但整节车厢瞬间安静下来。

九双眼睛齐刷刷转向他。

凌云第一个开口问道：“秦守，你真的发现巨蛇的弱点了？”

秦守指向窗外那条盘踞在古木之间的巨蛇，说道：“看它的腹部中央，有一片鳞片与周围的鳞片相反，如果我没猜错的话，那片鳞片是巨蛇的逆鳞，鳞片下方是它的心脏。”

陆小小凑到车窗边，眯着眼睛看了好一会儿，终于捕捉到那片灰色鳞片。

“我看到了，真的有一个相反的鳞片！是不是只要捅穿逆鳞，就能杀死巨蛇？”

“理论上可以。”

秦守摇了摇头。

“实际上不可能！巨蛇的战斗力太强了，我们根本没机会靠近它！”

车厢里沉默下来。

大家都明白秦守说的是事实。

以他们如今的战斗力，就算发现了巨蛇的弱点，依然无法与之对抗。

陆小小很不甘心。

“难道就真的没有办法了吗？”

秦守回答道：“等等吧，反正还有十二小时，说不定有转机！”

没有人提出异议，这是目前唯一可行的方案。

时间一分一秒地流逝。

一个小时。

两个小时。

三个小时。

巨蛇依然盘踞在那几棵古木之间，那双幽绿色的竖瞳从没离开过地铁车厢。

众人被堵在车厢内，只能看看聊天频道内的消息。

【我们地铁被一群巨大远古蜘蛛堵住了，已经三个小时了，出不去，谁有办法？】

【办法就是别出去！我们队伍出去两个人想引开外面的巨型老鼠，刚出去就被吃掉了，好惨啊！】

【我好饿，明明外面到处都是吃的，到处都有水，我们却只能躲在车厢里看着，我要崩溃了，啊啊啊啊——】

很多玩家都遭遇了和秦守等人一样的困境。

巨大的远古生物包围了地铁，他们被困在车厢内动弹不得。

和秦守等人不同的是，大部分玩家没有吃的，没有喝的，只能忍饥挨饿。

相比之下，秦守等人还是幸福的，至少不用为食物和水担心。

突然，一声极低沉极尖锐的嘶鸣穿透了浓雾，从森林深处疾速而来。

巨蛇的头猛地抬了起来。

蛇信子急速吞吐着，头颈转向雾气深处。

有什么东西正在靠近，而且数量不少。

森林深处传来更多嘶鸣声，带着某种节肢类生物特有的摩擦音。

紧接着，浓雾中冲出五只远古巨型蜘蛛。

这些家伙长得无比丑陋，灰白色的硬毛覆满躯干，八条长腿带着倒刺，口器不断开合，发出咔嚓咔嚓的摩擦声。

蜘蛛群受到规则之力限制，同样无法攻击车厢内的众人，它们的目标锁定盘踞的巨蛇。

巨蛇感受到了危机，身体缓缓展开，深色鳞片在雾气中闪烁着幽冷的光，喉咙深处发出低沉的嘶嘶声。

饿疯的蜘蛛群没有理会警告。

第一只从正面扑上去，八条腿同时弹地，整个身体凌空跃起，咬向巨蛇的脖颈。

巨蛇甩头迎击，上下颚张开，一口咬住了蜘蛛的腹部。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Shou's voice was not loud, but the whole carriage fell silent instantly.

Nine pairs of eyes turned to him.

Ling Yun was the first to ask: "Qin Shou, have you really discovered the giant snake's weakness?"

Qin Shou pointed to the giant snake coiled among the ancient trees outside the window and said: "Look at the center of its abdomen, there is a scale that is opposite to the surrounding scales. If I guessed correctly, that scale is the reverse scale of the giant snake, and below the scale is its heart."

Lu Xiaoxiao leaned towards the car window and squinted for a long time before finally catching the gray scales.

"I saw it. There really is an opposite scale! Can the giant snake be killed by just piercing the reverse scale?"

"Theoretically yes."

Qin Shou shook his head.

"It's actually impossible! The giant snake's fighting power is so strong that we have no chance of getting close to it!"

There was silence in the carriage.

Everyone understood that what Qin Shou said was true.

With their current fighting power, even if they discover the giant snake's weakness, they still can't fight it.

Lu Xiaoxiao was very unwilling.

"Is there really no other way?"

Qin Shou replied: "Wait a minute, there are still twelve hours anyway, maybe there will be a turn for the better!"

No one raised any objections and this was the only feasible solution at present.

Time passes minute by minute.

One hour.

Two hours.

Three hours.

The giant snake was still entrenched among the ancient trees, and its pair of dark green vertical pupils had never left the subway car.

Everyone was blocked in the carriage and could only read the messages in the chat channel.

[Our subway is blocked by a group of giant ancient spiders. It has been three hours and we can’t get out. Who can help?】

[The solution is not to go out!Two people from our team went out to try to lure away the giant rats outside, but they were eaten as soon as they went out. What a tragedy!】

[I’m so hungry. There’s food and water everywhere outside, but we can only hide in the carriage and watch. I’m going to collapse, ahhhhh——]

Many players have encountered the same dilemma as Qin Shou and others.

Huge ancient creatures surrounded the subway, and they were trapped in the carriage unable to move.

Unlike Qin Shou and others, most of the players had nothing to eat or drink, so they could only suffer from hunger.

In comparison, Qin Shou and others are still happy, at least they don't have to worry about food and water.

Suddenly, a very low and sharp scream penetrated the thick fog and came quickly from the depths of the forest.

The giant snake's head suddenly raised.

Snake Xinzi vomited rapidly, turning his head and neck to the depths of the mist.

Something is approaching, and there's a lot of it.

More neighing sounds came from deep in the forest, with the characteristic friction of some kind of arthropod.

Immediately afterwards, five ancient giant spiders rushed out of the thick fog.

These guys were extremely ugly, with gray-white bristles covering their torsos, eight long legs with barbs, and their mouthparts constantly opening and closing, making clicking sounds.

The spider swarm is restricted by the power of rules and cannot attack the people in the carriage. Their target is the entrenched giant snake.

The giant snake felt the crisis, and its body slowly unfolded. Its dark scales shone coldly in the mist, and a low hissing sound came from deep in its throat.

The hungry spiders ignored the warning.

The first one pounced from the front, its eight legs bounced off the ground at the same time, its entire body leaped into the air, and bit into the giant snake's neck.

The giant snake swung its head to attack, opened its upper and lower jaws, and bit the spider's abdomen.
